observation.visible_scene: A small cylindrical metal stove/burner rests on a tiered base atop a dark wooden table, set against a red brick wall. A flame burns from the burner's top, with a blue ring at its base and a yellow-white body rising above it. To the right sits a round black digital device with a screen showing numeric readouts and two round buttons (one blue, one green). The framing is static throughout.
visible_changes: The flame flickers and changes shape and height continuously: tall and columnar in some frames (e.g. 2, 8, 22, 25, 31), shorter and conical in others (1, 4, 6, 10, 12), and at times reduced to mostly the blue base ring with only a small yellow tip (13-16).

In several frames a yellow-orange flame blob appears above the main flame, joined by a thin neck or seemingly detached, sitting higher in the frame (2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 18, 20, 21, 32, 38, 41); its vertical position shifts upward across consecutive such frames, consistent with a buoyant flame puff rising from the tip.
The blue base ring and the small blue jets around the burner rim remain present the whole time.
The numeric readout on the round device changes between frames, while the green button stays lit and the blue dot remains.
The burner, the round device, the table, and the brick wall hold fixed screen positions; no camera movement is evident.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the flame's flickering and puffing (fuel flow, airflow, etc.) is not shown.
The meaning, units, and function of the device's changing numbers are not shown.
Behavior before t=0 and after t=1.33 s is not shown.
uncertain_details: The displayed digits are blurry and their values are not consistent with the ~1.3 s span, so the device's function and readings are uncertain.
Whether the upper yellow shapes are physically detached flames or motion-blurred flame tips cannot be confirmed.
